description: [Signal Desk] The dates the signal changed direction (long to short or back) over a lookback window, the drivers at each change, and the current direction. For questions like 'when did the model turn bearish on TSLA'. Requires a connected fAlpha account.

horizon.description: Holding period the reading is for, in trading days: hp5d (5), hp15d (15), hp2m (42, about two calendar months).
horizon.title: Horizon

lookback_days.description: How far back to look for direction flips, in days.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

regime.description: Market backdrop the model conditions on: neutral (no market view), bull or bear.
regime.title: Regime

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: falpha_signal_desk_flips
title: Signal direction flips
